name: libziskos
description: ZisK accelerators and syscalls (libziskos) for bflat guests

objects.note: In front of the linker script, where bflat linked --extlib static libraries before schema 2.

wrap.note: ziskos bump-allocator bridge onto the shared heap. The __wrap_ definition is in the pal module of bflat.

Per-call heap arena around the libziskos accelerators that allocate, which would otherwise leak their scratch memory into the never-freeing heap. The __wrap_ definitions are in the pal module of bflat: keep this list in step with its ZK_ACCEL_ARENA list (src/bflat/modules/pal/module.c).
